title: apbCatalogR: Look Up APB Result Fields by Meaning
description:
apbCatalogR looks up the fields of AnnData Proteomics Bridge (APB) results by meaning, such as a posterior error probability or an unnormalized intensity, without naming vendor columns. It is the R implementation of the apb-catalog API and works on the catalogue bundle apb-catalog releases.

apb2 converts the reports of quantification software such as AlphaDIA, DIA-NN, FragPipe, MaxQuant, PEAKS, Sage and Spectronaut into one layout: one AnnData per level, runs as obs, features as var, measurements as layers. The columns keep the vendors' names, so a posterior error probability is PEP in MaxQuant and EG_PEP in Spectronaut; apb-catalog records what each column means.

  • Catalog$new(software, version, set): the fields a software version reports, from the catalogue alone
  • read_parsed_levels(path): an APB result, h5ad, Parquet or DuckDB, as anndataR AnnData objects, one per level
  • DataCatalog$new(result, ...): the data of a result, looked up by key through anndataR's slots
  • catalogues(), catalogue_table(), rule_coverage(): the catalogue sets, their entries, and how each software version covers them

Documentation: anndata-omics-bridge.github.io/apbCatalogR
